About this item

  • PREMIUM AEROLIGHT TECHNOLOGY: Experience next-level hydration with the Stanley IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle, featuring AeroLight spun-steel insulation that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. This featherweight design ensures easy portability without compromising on cooling performance, keeping your water refreshingly cold for hours, perfect for staying hydrated during your daily activities or intense workouts.
  • ENHANCED HYDRATION: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid of this bottle is designed for convenience and speed. It comes with a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, allowing you to hydrate faster and easier. Simply flip to sip, snap it shut securely, and slip the bottle into your bag or car cupholder for on-the-go hydration.
  • LEAK-RESISTANT LID: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is engineered to be leak-resistant, ensuring that your beverages stay securely contained without accidental spills. The replaceable seal adds to the longevity of the bottle, allowing you to enjoy leak-free performance for extended periods. This thoughtful design feature enhances the overall usability and reliability of the bottle.
  • DISHWASHER SAFE: Designed with user convenience in mind, the IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle is dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning. Additionally, the new spout is removable, making it easier to clean for hygienic use every time. It’s the ideal companion for your active lifestyle, whether you're at the gym, on the trail, or commuting to work.
  • BUILT FOR LIFE: Since 1913 we've promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink, built to last a lifetime. It's a promise we still keep.

Product Description

Next level hydration. The IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle has premium AeroLight technology that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. Featherweight spun-steel insulation keeps your water ice-cold for hours. The folding handle attached to your flip straw water bottle makes this the perfect grab and go for a hot yoga class. The Flip Straw 2.0 lid has a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, so you can hydrate faster. Flip to sip, snap it shut and slip the water bottle into your bag. You can even pop off the new spout for a deeper clean.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

The flip straw works smoothly and makes it easy to drink while driving, working, or exercising. When the straw is completely closed, the bottle does not leak in my bag. This is a great option for anyone looking for a practical, durable water bottle for daily use. I would definitely recommend it.

    I love my new Stanley IceFlow Aerolight 50 oz bottle. It’s really beautiful and love the lilac colour. The straw hole is wider and comfortable to drink from. It doesn’t leak and is definitely much lighter than my Yeti 46 oz. However, I gave it 4 stars because it doesn’t keep ice and water as long as my Yeti. The ice lasts up to 8 or 9 hours then melts, but the water remains cool a while longer. My Yeti 46 oz can keep ice up to one and a half days. I guess to make it lighter the insulation is not as thick so it doesn’t maintain coldness as long as the double insulated Yetis. Update: April 1. I had to come back and write an additional update. The longer I have this bottle is the more I love it. It is keeping the ice and water longer now. Not sure why it wasn't when I just got it. It is beautiful holds a lot and I absolutely love it even more than my Yeti which I had really loved. It is so tall and slender and just beautiful. Thank you Stanley & Amazon!

Product Summary: STANLEY IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle, 24 oz, Soft Orchid | Easy Carry Handle | Twist On Lid and Flip Up Straw | Lightweight Water Bottle | Insulated Stainless Steel | BPA-Free

From STANLEY

4.7 out of 5 stars, 8,079 ratings

Customer reviews

1K+ bought in past week

Price

One-time purchase: $35.00

Purchasing options

Other sellers

About this Item

  • PREMIUM AEROLIGHT TECHNOLOGY: Experience next-level hydration with the Stanley IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle, featuring AeroLight spun-steel insulation that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. This featherweight design ensures easy portability without compromising on cooling performance, keeping your water refreshingly cold for hours, perfect for staying hydrated during your daily activities or intense workouts.
  • ENHANCED HYDRATION: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid of this bottle is designed for convenience and speed. It comes with a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, allowing you to hydrate faster and easier. Simply flip to sip, snap it shut securely, and slip the bottle into your bag or car cupholder for on-the-go hydration.
  • LEAK-RESISTANT LID: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is engineered to be leak-resistant, ensuring that your beverages stay securely contained without accidental spills. The replaceable seal adds to the longevity of the bottle, allowing you to enjoy leak-free performance for extended periods. This thoughtful design feature enhances the overall usability and reliability of the bottle.
  • DISHWASHER SAFE: Designed with user convenience in mind, the IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle is dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning. Additionally, the new spout is removable, making it easier to clean for hygienic use every time. It’s the ideal companion for your active lifestyle, whether you're at the gym, on the trail, or commuting to work.
  • BUILT FOR LIFE: Since 1913 we've promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink, built to last a lifetime. It's a promise we still keep.

Product Description

Next level hydration. The IceFlow Flip Straw 2.0 Bottle has premium AeroLight technology that makes it 33% lighter than standard stainless-steel bottles. Featherweight spun-steel insulation keeps your water ice-cold for hours. The folding handle attached to your flip straw water bottle makes this the perfect grab and go for a hot yoga class. The Flip Straw 2.0 lid has a larger drink opening and a built-in straw, so you can hydrate faster. Flip to sip, snap it shut and slip the water bottle into your bag. You can even pop off the new spout for a deeper clean.
